extensions.units: Android density-independent units: px in tokens means dp for size and sp for type.

plates.name: plate-offset
plates.purpose: How far the second plate rests out of register on primary and selected elements (AkaMotion.PlateOffset). Plate A top-start, plate B bottom-end; 0 while pressed.

plates.name: selection-plates
plates.purpose: Active session, latched modifiers, chosen options (dark scheme).

plates.name: grain
plates.value: 128px tiled speckle, seed 0x414B41, alpha 0.07 dark / 0.06 light
plates.purpose: Large printed fields only, under the content.

plates.name: hairline
plates.purpose: The one border weight (Federal Line on stock, translucent Federal Tint #A9BCF2 at 25% on the field).

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Routine state changes: switch track colour, sheet content size.

motion.name: print
motion.purpose: Budget for the wordmark's first two-pass print.

motion.name: register
motion.purpose: Plates settling into register: one visible overshoot, about 300ms. The signature motion.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The same settle without overshoot: switch thumb, large moves.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Plates and wordmark cut straight to register, switches snap, the working mark stops turning.

narrative.overview:
AkaTerminal is printed, not rendered. Every colour on screen is a risograph spot ink or the stock it is printed on: a blue-black dark stock, a Federal Blue field for the shell, Bright Red (aka) for the one primary action, and the plum overprint where red lands on blue to mark what is selected. Hierarchy comes from tone and ink, not from light and shadow. The terminal sits full bleed on the stock, so the terminal and the chrome read as one sheet.

The density is that of a tool used one-handed at night for long sessions. Rows are full width on the stock and grouped by small labels, not boxed in cards. Large printed fields (the drawer header, the Ubuntu status sheet, onboarding plates) carry a faint fixed-seed grain; nothing else does. The one signature motion is misregistration that registers: primary and selected elements rest with their second plate 2dp out of register, and a press settles the plates together with one damped overshoot. Reduced motion cuts instantly.

The system is Material 3 underneath (drawer, dialogs, radio buttons, progress, snackbars, system Back) restyled with the inks, a cut-paper shape scale and one type family. It ships dark only; the light scheme (cool white stock, deepened inks) is kept in the tokens so a later switch stays cheap. Dynamic (wallpaper) colour is off: the inks are fixed.
keyCharacteristics: Spot inks on dark stock; no greys, no gradients, no glass.
One primary ink (Red) and one selection ink (overprint plum), both printed as misregistered plates.
State told by mark form first, hue second.
One family, Archivo, ranked by width and weight; JetBrains Mono only for code, paths and key caps.
Cut-paper corners (2 to 14px), one hairline weight, no shadows.

rules.name: The Spot Ink Rule
rules.body: Every colour is one of the inks or the stock. New colours enter `Riso` and the schemes, never as a raw value in a screen. Screens read `MaterialTheme.colorScheme` or `AkaTheme.inks`.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is the action ink. One plated primary per screen region; secondary actions are outlined or text buttons.

rules.name: The Form-First Rule
rules.body: A state ink (green, yellow, pink) never appears without its mark form or its words. Hue is the second signal.

rules.name: The Night Rule
rules.body: The chrome never outshines the terminal text: fields stay dark blue, grain stays at 0.07 alpha or less, and no ink is used as a large bright fill except the one red primary.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo by width and weight, JetBrains Mono for code. No third face.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels and section heads are sentence case at their role's tracking. No uppercase tracked labels above headings.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: Lift a surface by changing its ink or tint step, never with a shadow or a glow.

rules.name: The Two-Plate Rule
rules.body: Misregistration belongs to primary and selected elements only: plate A peeks top-start and plate B bottom-end, both 2px, and they register (offset 0) on press with the `register` spring. It is never a decorative offset shadow on cards, rows or text.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: Grain (fixed seed, 0.07 alpha dark, 0.06 light) prints only on large fields, under the content, never behind small body text.

dos: Do take every colour from `MaterialTheme.colorScheme` or `AkaTheme.inks`; new inks go into `Riso` first.
Do print the main action of a region as one PlatedButton and keep the rest outlined or text.
Do pair every state ink with a StatusMark form or plain words.
Do group settings and actions as full-width AkaRows under SectionLabels on the stock.
Do use the shape scale (2, 4, 6, 10, 14) and `FluxSpacing`, never raw dp for padding.
Do honour reduced motion: plates and wordmark cut to register, switches snap.
Do set code, paths and commands in JetBrains Mono (`CodeStyle`).
donts: Don't use drop shadows, glows, gradients, glass or tonal elevation tints.
Don't put the misregistered offset on anything that is not a primary or selected element.
Don't set Federal (#3255A4) as text on stock; use Federal Tint.
Don't use white text on Red, Yellow or Pink fills; use Ink Text.
Don't add uppercase tracked kickers or eyebrows above headings.
Don't print grain behind small body text or across the terminal.
Don't use Rounded or Outlined icon sets, emoji or text glyphs as icons outside key caps.
